The CDC's "Measles Cases and Outbreaks" page lists 3,471 cases nationwide as of Sept. 18. There were 2,289 in all of 2025.

Of the 3,471 cases, 9% — 301 individuals — have resulted in hospitalizations. In addition, of all cases, 95% were in those not vaccinated with the MMR shot, which Merck (MRK) and GSK (GSK) market in the U.S.
Pennsylvania is the hardest-hit state, with 792 cases as of Sept. 21.
Recently, Pennsylvania Secretary of Health Debra Bogen asked the CDC for rapid-response assistance known as Epi-Aid, but
the agency recognizes the state's four measles-associated deaths.
